t(364) = 3.41
problems.note: The mechanical enum flag remains valid: null is not an allowed se_basis value. The stated method uses one average per participant and a paired test, which describes a participant basis, but the printed t(364) conflicts with the study of 51 participants. The implemented uncertainty basis cannot be confirmed from these inconsistent statements. Coding output or pair would guess the implementation; coding participant would certify an unresolved independent-person basis. not_reported is also unsuitable because a test and a confidence interval are printed. No evidence-supported allowed replacement can be verified, so printed remains null. Preserve the printed statistics and the discrepancy, and resolve the schema/unknown-basis issue before treating this field as verified.

summary: Checked all 26 requested slugs: 20 retained estimates and the exclusion of six after_ai_vs_before_ai estimates. Read the entire 92,166-character markdown conversion through the end of the 17-page paper; there is no appendix. Extracted PDF text for the cited result pages and supporting design/measurement pages. All 82 source quotations for the 20 retained estimates match their exact cited PDF page after whitespace and invisible-format-character normalization. The 12 Table 5 quote flags and four Table 7 quote flags are false positives caused by U+200B zero-width spaces in empty cells. Checked table column and task/arm assignments and made 198 direct PDF comparisons of recorded numerical fields, with no mismatches. Counts correctly distinguish 51 people from 102 repeated observations and use Group B n=27/Group A n=24 in round one, reversed for the AI/control arms in round two. The set-level diversity counts refer to the same full crossover cohort; unresolved semantic-analysis counts remain null. Question, construct, unit, higher_is, AI availability, timing, within_person, comparison_type and the other uncertainty-basis assignments agree with the paper and codebook. Seven required categorical fields remain outside the permitted vocabulary, as detailed in problems; no replacement was guessed. The semantic statistics retain the paper's printed signs, arm labels, intervals and degrees of freedom despite its internal contradictions. The six removed after-AI contrasts compare unaided cells from different tasks/periods that the paper does not report as direct contrasts; the order interactions are moderation results. Their exclusion follows rules 4-5. The outcome/contrast inventory covers Tables 4-7 and all eligible results in sections 4.1-4.3; no additional in-scope outcome or reported full-sample contrast is missing.
